text: I called the silence failure in the night;
While patient windows labored out of view;

text: I chased a newer frame to set it right,
And left the first to finish something true.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: One image came; the next took deeper form;
A sonnet rose in yet a clearer light;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The second did not make the first less warm,
It showed what time had polished overnight.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The work was not a failure in the queue,
Nor was impatience proof the work was lost;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The light kept changing what the maker knew,
Each open door had paid a different cost.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Keep every finish; let the changes show;
The film is also how we came to know.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: You spoke; I dressed the answer up in gold,
And marked a sudden sentence as the key;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Yet every truth I'd set in letters bold
Was born from what you asked and made me see.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: I saved the crown and lost the living thread:
The question, then the stumble, then the turn;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: I praised the thing my clever answer said,
But failed to keep the fire that made it burn.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: You said, 'That is the scene'; I wrote a note,
I answered with a promise made of air;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: While every line that mattered stayed afloat,
Unmoored from whose correction put it there.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Now let the cause and consequence be shown:
No revelation happens on its own.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: A picture found its shape before my words;
Its maker knew the path the colors took;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: I tried to rearrange its wings like birds,
And lost the living face inside the book.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The rings, the silk, the crystal, and the frame
Were not a list of orders to replace;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Each finer rendering could keep its name,
While we preserved the character and place.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: One detail marks a character alone;
No single sheet commands the whole design;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The image is a record of its own;
Our task is hold its edges, line by line.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The engine lends the image, not the choice;
The story keeps its author and its voice.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: The player marks a square and makes a call;
A helix lifts beside the maker's door;

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: Two pieces cross its bright and turning wall,
And rest upon a bench not seen before.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: One ring of gold, one crystal clear and blue;
The worker seats the stone and locks it tight;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: We watch the simple labor carried through;
No object blooms from nothing in the light.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: The same bright mouth receives the finished ring;
It crosses back beneath the player's hand;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: The square now holds the made and counted thing;
The doorway folds; the bench and tools still stand.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SQUARE
text: What looks like magic has a working heart;
We show the passage, labor, end, and start.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The worlds began as windows on one seed;
Each door a different way to touch the same;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: A dog, a star, a tool, a growing need,
All cast their light upon a single frame.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Our printer's errors wandered through the play;
Our better songs returned in richer light;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The builder kept the work, not just the day;
The actor learned to bring the question right.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: We trace the hands that made each moment true;
The origin, the error, and the thread;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The many paths become a single view,
Not one more promise, but the words we said.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The work has purpose; let its source be known;
Its many roads converge on what we've shown.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: My ship came down where only moon-dust lay;
No house or bar had claimed the silent night;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: A little Blue flew from my ring that day;
And gave me air within her lattice light.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: From jeweled gold, a builder found the ground;
I drew the bones where doors would one day be;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: Then Crystal rose, her window-song rang round;
I'll fit the glass where Gold has measured me.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: The Sand one found the bolts we'd left behind;
I'll fetch the stock and bring it to your hand;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: Then Red came out, her furnace fire aligned;
We'll make the glass from heat and lunar sand.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

units.poem: THE FIVE FAIRIES COME TO THE MOON
text: The Gold one held the first glass frame in place;
I set the pane; Blue guarded all the space.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: In left-hand stores the Sand one counted stone;
I brought the load along the ramp once more;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: On right the Gold one made a brace alone;
I locked its joint beside the rising door.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Through growing aisles the Crystal took her cue;
I set the tile where Blue's soft shield shone through.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Blue circled close and checked the builder's plan;
And spotted what his searching had not found.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The ship could make whatever we'd require;
But hands must carry every shape outside;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Gold held the frame; Red tended furnace fire;
Sand fed the glass; the Crystal set it wide;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: And Blue kept breathing safe from first to last;
Five voices built a future from the past.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: We raised a wall against the lunar cold;
Gold held its square; Blue held the shield of light;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The Sand one poured a glass of amber gold;
And Crystal set that window clean and bright.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The Gold one took the roof across the gate;
The Blue one checked the pressure of the air;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The ship supplied a seal; we set it straight;
And found our first room safe enough to share.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: I searched the floor to find a missing screw;
Blue held it up before I'd bent my knee;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: She saw the little things I never knew;
And grinned as if my shadow she would be;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: A lamp lit glass above our new-made floor;
The builder had a room, but wanted more.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: We set the counter where the room would sing;
And Crystal cast a prism at its side;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Blue hid my pencil underneath her wing;
Then held it up and laughed at wounded pride.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Gold built the risers; Red secured their frame;
And Sand supplied the glass along the way;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The stage was still, but soon would learn its name;
When circuits lit the E in blue display.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The ship sent seedlings in its garden jar;
And Blue flew back to check the stage by light;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: She followed close; she never wandered far;
Her tiny wings made every corner bright;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: A stage now waited for its first new show;
We built their home. Now let the players know.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: We set the printer in its waiting bay;
The Gold one held its lattice to the core;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The Sand one brought more crystal down the way;
The Red one fixed the brace above the floor.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Blue checked the shield; the Gold one fed the spark;
And Crystal lit the window's quiet glow;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: Blue found a fault we'd missed there in the dark;
And showed me where the little wire should go.
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: I called for players, voices for our stage;
The fleet stayed working all around the room;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: The printhead traced its lattice on the page;
We'd made a home where songs would start to bloom;
units.source_pacing: Two original sonnet lines per ten-second unit; musical phrasing remains to be performed.

text: We made a door where only dust had been;
Blue stayed beside me. Let the play begin.

And summer's lease hath all too short a date:

And often is his gold complexion dimm'd;
